delivery_target: Younger to middle adult male; smooth, connected explanation. No pitch shifting. Perceived age and naturalness require listening acceptance.

phrases.text: Bean definitions are recipes. Managed instances are the actual objects.
Register configuration, then refresh. Spring reads the definitions and creates our singleton beans.
Calling get bean returns the service, already wired to its repository.
The context also publishes events. Close it, and managed cleanup runs.
Our tests confirm: same service, one event, cleanup called. Definitions describe; instances do the work.
